gloss: relay pitching; use of relief pitchers

definitions.gloss: relay pitching; using relief pitchers in succession
definitions.explanation: In baseball, the strategy of bringing in one pitcher after another over the course of a game rather than letting a single starter finish. Also used with する.

examples.japanese: {継|けい}{投|とう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逃|に}げ→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: To hold on to the win with relay pitching.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{継|けい}{投|とう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The manager decided to go to the bullpen early.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投手|とうしゅ}→投手：06563_toushu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{継|けい}{投|とう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦{打線|だせん}→打線：30021_dasen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}えた→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: They shut down the opposing lineup with a relay of three pitchers.

notes:
A baseball term. Frequently used as {継|けい}{投|とう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ('to bring in relievers') and in the phrase {継|けい}{投|とう}⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧ ('bullpen strategy').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {継|けい}{投|とう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to relay pitchers; to change pitchers
- {継|けい}{投|とう}⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧: relief-pitching strategy
- {継|けい}{投|とう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: the pitching change pays off

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{完投|かんとう}→完投：24619_kantou⟧: complete game — one pitcher throwing the entire game, the opposite approach
